qualification: Original ROM and unchanged private OS media; fresh private state; ordinary Mode input only. Passthrough read taps. Limited to observed boot/setup paths, no dormant-use exclusion.

runs.observer:
local cpu=manager.machine.devices[':maincpu'] local s=cpu.spaces['program']
local reads=0 local active=true local frames=0
sense=s:install_write_tap(0xe002,0xe003,'sense-command-observer',function(a,d,m) if active and cpu.state['PC'].value==0x019f then print(string.format('[SENSE-IMMEDIATE] pc=%04x data=%04x mask=%04x',cpu.state['PC'].value,d,m)) end end)
byteprobe=s:install_read_tap(0x8902,0x8907,'rom-byte-probe',function(a,d,m)
 if active then reads=reads+1 print(string.format('[READ] addr=%04x pc=%04x data=%04x mask=%04x selector=%04x',a,cpu.state['PC'].value,d,m,s:read_u16(0x10c))) end
end)
handoff=s:install_write_tap(0x106,0x107,'rom-byte-handoff',function(a,d,m) if cpu.state['PC'].value==0x4755 and active then print('[HANDOFF] reads='..reads) active=false end end)
emu.register_frame_done(function() frames=frames+1 if frames%300==0 then print(string.format('[STATE] frame=%d pc=%04x reads=%d',frames,cpu.state['PC'].value,reads)) end end)
